verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe installing Omarchy alongside Windows/other OSes via 'Omarchy Quattro' (single-partition dual-boot) and a dedicated manual page for dual-booting beside Windows, with a community user referencing intent to dual-boot it on a work laptop. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the dual-boot install process works smoothly end-to-end, and details on dual-booting with non-Windows OSes.
